rules: Do not write new content to legacy data/ files.
Do not delete legacy data/ files during Phase 1.
Preserve source-specific differences until reviewed against owner-approved canon.
Use stable IDs for cross-system references; display names are not keys.
Use assets/data/locations.json as the canonical source for map-linked location records.
Use assets/data/quests.json as the canonical source for authored in-world quests; do not convert UI achievements or development tasks into quests.
Quest definitions belong in assets/data/quests.json; per-player quest state belongs in the local progression store until a backend is approved.
Do not treat development checklist items as in-world quests.
Item, currency and collection definitions belong in assets/data/items.json; player holdings belong in the separate local inventory save.
Do not enable quest reward granting until item references resolve and duplicate awards are prevented by an idempotent reward receipt.
Location discovery targets reference assets/data/locations.json by stable ID; player discoveries are stored separately in a local guest save.
Collectible discoveries reference approved item IDs; discovery recording does not grant inventory items or unlock gallery artwork unless an explicit approved reward mapping exists.
Relationship catalogue entries reference canonical character IDs; do not invent relationship scores or character history.
Player-authored companion journal entries remain separate from character canon and AI memory.
Existing YouthSpark visitor progression is browser-local interface progression, not canonical affection or trust.
Do not grant rewards or unlock quests from relationship progression without an approved mapping.
Muse-Core memory records are explicit player-authored local notes until an approved backend and consent model exist.
Core, Relationship, Episodic and Symbolic are separate memory categories; do not silently convert journal entries into memory.
Memory importance is a transparent weighted organizational score, not a model judgment or emotional inference.
A locally retained memory is not automatically character canon or injected into AI model context.
Preserve canonical character identity and personality; memory records must not overwrite character source data.
